Objective: Adrian completes his first day of the male-fertility trial, establishing the baseline routine of medication intake and specimen collection while confronting the immediate physical and psychological costs of the regimen.
IntendedChange: Adrian transitions from a desperate, exhausted student preparing for the trial to a participant who has successfully completed the first cycle, receiving his initial payment and experiencing the first subtle, confusing physical side effects of the drug.
ProhibitedPatterns: Do not resolve the nanite interaction or reveal the existence of the nanites to Adrian.
Do not have the clinic technician offer personal sympathy, break protocol, or acknowledge Adrian's emotional state.
Do not complete the second or third days of the trial; this chapter covers only the first day.
Do not introduce Lena Reyes or any romantic/sexual partner in this chapter.
Do not have Adrian skip the trial to work his part-time job; he must prioritize the trial.

Scenes.Purpose: Adrian arrives at the clinic early, taking his first dose of the fertility medication in the sterile waiting area while managing rising nausea and the rigid timing constraints of the protocol.
Scenes.IntendedChange: Adrian has ingested the medication and is physically present in the specimen collection room, having accepted the loss of his part-time job shift to meet the trial's strict schedule.

Scenes.Purpose: Adrian undergoes the specimen collection process with the clinic technician, enduring the clinical, dehumanizing nature of the interaction while experiencing a moment of severe nausea that risks violating timing protocols.
Scenes.IntendedChange: Adrian has successfully provided the specimen, the technician has logged the data without breaking professional boundaries, and Adrian has recovered from the nausea, establishing the baseline routine and the power imbalance in their dynamic.

Scenes.Purpose: Adrian receives his initial payment and the detailed payment structure explanation from the clinic administrator, discovering that his income is tied to consistent attendance and sample quality, while noticing subtle physical changes like increased body heat and hunger.
Scenes.IntendedChange: Adrian has secured his financial relief for the day, understood the high-stakes dependency on his performance, and is returning to his apartment with a mix of relief and exhaustion, unaware of the deeper changes the medication is causing.
